description: This file defines the 'Unit' result class for a database schema using DBIx::Class in Perl. It specifies the table 'units', its columns, primary key, unique constraints, relationships to other tables (such as conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, items), and includes methods for retrieving related units and conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Unit
classes.description: A class representing the 'units' table in the database, with relationships to conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, and items, and methods for retrieving related units and conversions.

methods.name: convertible_into
methods.description: Returns all units that the current unit can be converted into, based on the 'conversions' relationship.

methods.name: find_conversion_into
methods.description: Finds a specific conversion record between the current unit and another specified unit.
